scope: Standing Queensland Museum Kurilpa at South Bank, Brisbane, including the stepped concrete collection volumes, the full-height Grey Street Museum Garden, and the glazed street entrance with its attached approach to the Melbourne Street Overpass.

references.caption: Queensland Museum and walkway to bus station and QPAC (Queensland Performing Arts Centre).
references.alt: Queensland Museum and walkway to bus station and QPAC (Queensland Performing Arts Centre).

originalReview.notes: The original shows the meeting of the broad pale concrete museum volume, the clear glazed two-storey entry under a dark projecting canopy, and the attached covered concrete overpass. It guides the surviving building shell and entrance vocabulary.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Figaro exterior already in Qualla is the rights-cleared architectural reference. The matching native item records the named uploader and explicit PD-user grant. The 2017 Arts Queensland conservation text documents the standing body and later glazed entry. Photographs of earlier homes, interior exhibits and other material were excluded.
